cases.expected_canonical_sql: SELECT SUM(source_view.room_revenue_krw) FILTER(WHERE source_view.business_date >= CAST(:start_date AS DATE) AND source_view.business_date < CAST(:end_date AS DATE)) AS room_revenue_krw, SUM(source_view.room_revenue_krw) FILTER(WHERE source_view.business_date >= CAST(:comparison_start_date AS DATE) AND source_view.business_date < CAST(:comparison_end_date AS DATE)) AS room_revenue_krw__comparison FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.hotel_operations_daily AS source_view WHERE (source_view.business_date >= CAST(:start_date AS DATE) AND source_view.business_date < CAST(:end_date AS DATE)) OR (source_view.business_date >= CAST(:comparison_start_date AS DATE) AND source_view.business_date < CAST(:comparison_end_date AS DATE)) LIMIT 500
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(source_view.room_revenue_krw) FILTER(WHERE source_view.business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND source_view.business_date < DATE '2025-09-01') AS room_revenue_krw, SUM(source_view.room_revenue_krw) FILTER(WHERE source_view.business_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND source_view.business_date < DATE '2025-08-01') AS room_revenue_krw__comparison FROM serving.analytics_v4_3.hotel_operations_daily AS source_view WHERE (source_view.business_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND source_view.business_date < DATE '2025-09-01') OR (source_view.business_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND source_view.business_date < DATE '2025-08-01') LIMIT 500
